lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土里闪出金点。
lines.en: Where I walk, gold flecks shine in the soil.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路一圈一圈发黄。
lines.en: The bands on me glow yellow, ring by ring.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，很慢，很得意。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and rather smugly.

lines.zh: 我踩过一块石头，石边黄了。
lines.en: I step on a stone; its edge yellows.
I choose the bright places to walk.
My step is light, but I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块金子转，不肯走。
lines.en: I circle a bit of gold and refuse to leave.

lines.zh: 我蹭过墙，墙上留了金粉。
lines.en: I brush a wall and leave gold dust.

lines.zh: 我往前走，身后一片金光。
lines.en: I walk on, and a track of gold glitters behind.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看着自己的影子。
lines.en: I stop and look at my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我拖着身体，像拖着一袋钱。
lines.en: I drag myself along like a sack of coins.

lines.zh: 我朝有金属味的方向去。
lines.en: I head toward the smell of metal.

lines.zh: 我一脚一脚把土踩成金色。
lines.en: Step by step I tread the soil to gold.
I squeeze through a heap of stone.
I crush a piece of gravel.
I pulse as I walk.
I stand, gold light moving over me.

lines.zh: 我在看一块石头里的纹路。
lines.en: I study the grain inside a stone.

lines.zh: 我身上的金色比刚才更亮。
lines.en: My gold is brighter than before.
I swell slowly once.
I lower my head, as if counting.
Even my shadow is yellow.

lines.zh: 我在等谁踩上这条金脉。
lines.en: I wait for someone to step on this gold seam.
I shudder; gold dust falls.
I stare at the ground, well satisfied.
I am in no hurry. Good things are worth waiting for.
My flecks blink on and off.
I turn half a circle on the spot.
I rub the stone under me.
I look up to see where the light comes from.

lines.zh: 我像一块会呼吸的金子。
lines.en: I am a breathing lump of gold.
I draw myself tighter.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，金光扫过你的脸。
lines.en: I look up; gold light sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 你身上闻不到金属的腥气。
lines.en: You carry none of that metallic tang.
I tilt my head, appraising your worth.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的金就亮一档。
lines.en: Each step you retreat brightens my gold.

lines.zh: 我吸一口气，金光涨起来。
lines.en: I draw a breath and my gold swells.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你手里那点金属光。
lines.en: What I stare at is the metallic glint in your hand.
The iron on you does not impress me.
I look at the ground beside you.
You are standing in a good spot.
I do not call out. Gold does not call out.

lines.zh: 我把金光收拢，贴向地面。
lines.en: I gather my glow close to the ground.

lines.zh: 你多看一会儿，我就更亮。
lines.en: The longer you look, the brighter I get.

lines.zh: 我身上的金色沉了一层，又亮起。
lines.en: The gold on me sinks a shade, then comes back.
I deflate, then swell again.
A little gold dust falls.

lines.zh: 我退开，身后落了一路金粉。
lines.en: I back away, leaving a trail of gold dust.
My seam has lengthened a little.

lines.zh: 我抖落了一身的金色碎屑。
lines.en: I shake loose a whole coat of gold flecks.
A dull sound comes from me.
I guard my middle.
I do not mean to burst early.

lines.zh: 我拖着满身金光往后挪。
lines.en: I drag my coat of gold light backward.
I do not eat this either.
I only check whether it is gold.
It is not gold. I do not want it.
You set it before me.

lines.zh: 我把它掀进旁边的石缝。
lines.en: I tip it into the nearby crack.

lines.zh: 我要的是石头，不是这个。
lines.en: I want stone, not this.
I step on it. Nothing changes.

lines.zh: 我继续看你身后的石头。
lines.en: I go back to watching the stone behind you.

lines.zh: 你举得再高，我只看着石头。
lines.en: Raise it as you will; I look only at stone.

lines.zh: 我一脚把它踢出金光外。
lines.en: I kick it out of my ring of light.
I give half a step of room.

lines.zh: 收进袋里，别在我面前晃。
lines.en: Put it away; do not wave it at me.
I do not even sniff it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛黏在你身后的石壁上。
lines.en: My eyes are stuck on the wall behind you.
I walk around it and past.

lines.zh: 它横在路中间，我绕过去。
lines.en: It lies across my path, so I go around.
You hit me; my gold light wavers.

lines.zh: 我沉得像锭金子，推不动。
lines.en: I am heavy as an ingot; I do not budge.
When you pull back, your palm is yellow.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，金粉飘起来。
lines.en: We collide; gold dust fills the air.

lines.zh: 我侧身，不想这么早结束。
lines.en: I turn aside. I do not want it to end yet.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟压到我的脚，我抽开。
lines.en: Your heel presses my foot; I pull it free.

lines.zh: 你的甲上多了一道金痕。
lines.en: A gold streak appears on your armor.

lines.zh: 我不生气，我只是看着你。
lines.en: I am not angry. I only look at you.
I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我们分开，地上多了一片黄。
lines.en: We part; a patch of yellow remains.
The other is yellower than I am.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，地上两条金线。
lines.en: We walk side by side, two gold lines.
We trade a little gold dust.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我的光更亮了。
lines.en: It leans in, and my light grows brighter.

lines.zh: 我们一起把一片石头染黄。
lines.en: Together we yellow a stretch of stone.
We pulse at the same moment.

lines.zh: 它慢慢退开，我跟了两步。
lines.en: It eases away; I follow two steps.

lines.zh: 我们之间落了一层金粉。
lines.en: A layer of gold dust settles between us.
It lowers its head, content.
This ground is worth a lot now.

lines.zh: 我把它按在我的金光里看。
lines.en: I hold it inside my glow and look.
I weigh it and put it back.
I watch it shine, satisfied.
It is not gold.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来，看有没有金色。
lines.en: I flip it over to check for gold.
It slowly yellows under my feet.
I push it beside a stone.

lines.zh: 我用身子把它按在石头边上。
lines.en: I pin it against the stone with my body.
A bit of gold dust clings to it.
I drop it and leave.
That stone you stand on is nice.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，金光漫到脚边。
lines.en: I swell, and light spills to my feet.
I begin counting steps.

lines.zh: 我朝你旁边那堆石头挪。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the stones beside you.
Walking off will not help.
All my flecks are lit.

lines.zh: 这块石头的位置我记牢了。
lines.en: I have fixed the spot of this stone.

lines.zh: 这里的石头，我想换一换。
lines.en: I would like to change this stone.
I do not chase. I arrive.

lines.zh: 你还有三步的时间走开。
lines.en: You have three steps' worth of time to leave.
I close on you step by step.
You retreat; my pace does not change.
My glow keeps brightening.
There is plenty of stone where you stand.
I am in no hurry. Gold can wait.

lines.zh: 我从亮的那边绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I come around your flank from the lit side.

lines.zh: 我把金光一寸寸挪到你脚下。
lines.en: I push my light toward your feet, inch by inch.
You shoot me; I keep walking.
I have already picked this ground.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩几步的金光。
lines.en: Only a few steps of gold light remain.
I do not fight people. I alter stone.
I bump you. It is only a shove.
I press close; the gold light is hot.
My seams line up with the ground.
I swell to the fullest and stop.
I burst, and the stone gleams.
That one step back was just right.
Gold everywhere in the flash.
This one changed a whole patch.
I take one last look at my work.
I light up in a crack of stone.
The soil under me yellows first.
I give one slow pulse.
The stone here is too plain.

lines.zh: 我朝有金属味的方向走。
lines.en: I head for the smell of metal.
I stop on a bare rock.
My flecks shine for the first time.
I know which stone to turn gold.
I begin reckoning distances.
I wait for the first thing to come near.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的金面，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Fire bakes my golden surface. I dislike it.
I fall, and every seam opens.
Water presses me; my light sinks.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸先点了我的引线。
lines.en: Another blast lights my fuse first.
An arrow lodges in my seam.

lines.zh: 那光把我的压力抽走一截。
lines.en: That light draws off some of my pressure.

lines.zh: 太久没碰到石头，我快散了。
lines.en: Too long without stone; I am coming apart.
Lightning fires me early.
I am pulled away, and nothing changes.
